title: Sotsugyou Album
overview:
A Sotsugyou series 10th anniversary commemorative disc that collects nostalgic illustrations and voices without leaving anything out!!

Over 200 original artworks, including newly drawn pieces, included in high resolution!

Over 15 minutes of movies, including the "Sotsugyou Reunion" with popular voice actors!!

懐かしのイラストや音声を余すところなく収めた卒業シリーズ10周年記念ディスク!!

書き下ろしを含む200枚以上の原画をハイレゾで収録!

人気声優による『卒業同窓会』など、ムービーが15分以上!!
